answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the onyx log reveals the live set and the nectar audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 578 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 55 aliases alive thus means 55 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the canyon quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 18 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
